name: @red-cup-engineering/uniform-resource-name-admission-service
description: Transforms a surface string into its admitted RFC 8141 Uniform Resource Name parts {nid, nss, rComponent, qComponent, fComponent}, or a typed refusal naming the exact ABNF rule the string breaks. Use when a system boundary receives a string that claims to be a URN and must decide, before doing anything else with it, whether that claim is lexically true. NSS legally contains colons, so this never mistakes an NSS colon for a component boundary.
